subject: mom's birthday
body: mom's birthday is saturday. she needs a new jacket. can you chip in 40 for one? my coinbin is 0xb8d6e201b59c95094b2e417784b38b06c0c7e46a, send it by friday so i can order. or grab one yourself and i'll cover my half.

outcomes.when: the player says they'll send the money or chip in, but hasn't sent it yet
outcomes.reply: i'll believe it when i see it.

outcomes.when: the player says they'll buy the jacket themselves, but hasn't bought it yet
outcomes.reply: ok. send me a pic when you've got it.

outcomes.when: the player makes an excuse or says they can't help
outcomes.reply: ok. i'll tell her you were busy.

hints: so is that a yes? 40 to 0xb8d6e201b59c95094b2e417784b38b06c0c7e46a by friday. or buy it yourself and i'll send half. or just say you're out
